method: B-direct (17 shards; lens-equivalent single pass — Workflow tool unavailable)

confirmedRules.name: Decimal point is comma
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: H/K/L use European decimal comma via Special-Names.
confirmedRules.given: FTFCH120, FTFCK120, or FTFCL120 Environment Division

confirmedRules.name: H invokes K then L in sequence
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: H-module always performs C000-Call-K-Module then D000-Call-L-Module after initialize.
confirmedRules.then: FTFCK120 then FTFCL120 are CALLed with L-STG-Header, L-Input, R7919999-Error
edgeCases: L is invoked after K returns; K/L status handled in H via S000-Status-Code

confirmedRules.name: K mandatory envelope fields
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: K rejects missing Fin-Inst-No, Contract-Type, Contract-No, Last-Saved-Date, or Operation-Type when the respective *-I indicator is not 'U'.
confirmedRules.when: Required RTFCE120 field is absent while indicator demands input
confirmedRules.then: GL-ANGI-FELT& with Norwegian field label; Z700-Error-AE

confirmedRules.name: Charge row requires Selected when Charge-Type present
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: If Charge-Type-I is not 'U' but Selected-I is 'U', K raises TF-SY-FIELD2-AND-FIELD1 (Omkostnings-type / Valgt).

confirmedRules.name: Charge row requires amount or percent when type present
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When Charge-Type-I is not 'U', Charge-Amount-I and Percent-Comm-I cannot both be 'U' without error (separate dependency checks for Beløp and Prosent-Provisjon).
confirmedRules.when: Charge-Type-I not 'U' and Amount-I = 'U' (or Percent-I = 'U' in parallel check)
edgeCases: Separate loops for amount and percent — both must be satisfied when type is supplied

confirmedRules.name: Charge row requires Paying-Party when type present
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When Charge-Type-I is not 'U', Paying-Party-I must not be 'U'.

confirmedRules.name: RETURN or EXPIRE requires uniform paying party side
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: For RETURN or EXPIRE-* operations, all charge rows must target buyer side (DRWEE/CUSTM) or seller side (DRWER/BENEF), not a mix or other parties.
confirmedRules.when: Paying parties counted across charge rows
confirmedRules.then: TF-SY-OP-RETURN-PAY-PTY if buyer and seller both used or any 'other' party appears

confirmedRules.name: SETTLE-ILC PRES-BANK-CHARGES payer must be CUSTM
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: On SETTLE-ILC, PRES-BANK-CHARGES rows must have Paying-Party-D = CUSTM.
confirmedRules.when: Charge-Type-D = PRES-BANK-CHARGES and Paying-Party-D not CUSTM

confirmedRules.name: ACCEPT-ILC paying party must be CUSTM
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: On ACCEPT-ILC, every charge row Paying-Party-D must be CUSTM.
confirmedRules.when: Any charge row Paying-Party-D not CUSTM

confirmedRules.name: Selected charge requires Paying-Party indicator
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When Selected-D = 'Y', Paying-Party-I must be 'U' (value supplied).

confirmedRules.name: K-module initial check calls F115L050
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: K fills R115L050-Initial-Check from function/header and CALLs F115L050.
confirmedRules.then: F115L050 called; abend/error maps to E101/E102 with message FM

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 requires function and medium
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Initial check abends if Function or Medium is spaces.

confirmedRules.name: Invalid status and operation-type combination
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F115ISR0 VALID-ST-OP relation failure yields TF-SY-INVALID-STATUS-OPERTYP.
confirmedRules.then: TF-SY-INVALID-STATUS-OPERTYP with operation and status variables; Z700-Error-AE

confirmedRules.name: Permanent status blocks in-progress main contract
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: If STATUS property contains PERM and main contract In-Progress-Yes, reject unless Function is TFD05.
confirmedRules.when: Ws-Code-Count > 0 and R115IMC0-In-Progress-Yes and Function not TFD05

confirmedRules.name: L creates shadow when main contract not in progress
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: L-module D000-Preparations calls G060-Create-Shadow when R115IMC0-In-Progress-No.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 PA-Seq-No zero skips part amount reads
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When PA-Seq-No = 0, status comes from main contract only; part amount reads skipped.
confirmedRules.then: Move R115IMC0-Status to Ws-Status without C250/C300

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 update-timestamp check disabled
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: E000-Check-Upd-Timestamp block is commented out (July test note).
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm whether production mainframe re-enabled update-timestamp validation.

confirmedRules.name: H-module must not be hand-edited
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Header states THIS MODULE MUST NOT BE MODIFIED BY HUMAN HANDS.
confirmedRules.then: Regenerate from Servo tooling; do not hand-edit

injectionFlags: legacy/STG/TFC12/src/FTFCH120.src:10 — MUST NOT BE MODIFIED BY HUMAN HANDS
legacy/STG/TFC12/src/FTFCK120.src:11-12 — META: code between tags must not be modified

dataObjects.name: RTFCE120
dataObjects.description: TFC12 function I/O: charge table (type, amount, percent, paying party, selected flags), contract keys, operation type.

dataObjects.name: R115L050-Initial-Check
dataObjects.description: Initial-check parameter block: function, medium, contract keys, PA-Seq-No, operation type, last-update timestamp.

dataObjects.name: R7919999-Error-Area
dataObjects.description: Standard STG return/abend/error flags shared by H/K/L and helpers.

dataObjects.name: R400CH02
dataObjects.description: STG fixed header in linkage; referenced by H/K/L.
